correctness.rationale: The phasor closure of three strict positive weights has cyclic angular gaps π−γ_j, so the shortest containing phase arc length is π+γ_min. The actual projected-site interval covering these phases has width at least c(w)=1/2+γ_min/(2π), and Cauchy–Schwarz bounds it above by |ξ|D. Both equalities demand minimal-arc lifts and a diameter segment parallel to ξ. For equal weights the three projections are 0,1/3,2/3; their extreme diameter endpoints therefore have third-site projection at the midpoint, but its perpendicular distance may be ZERO. The original final RESULT.md incorrectly claimed only NONCOLLINEAR isosceles equality triangles. Counterexample weights 1, sites (0,0),(D/2,0),(D,0), ξ=(2/(3D),0) has F=1+e^(−2πi/3)+e^(−4πi/3)=0 at equality. A FULL corrected RESULT.md includes both collinear and noncollinear isosceles configurations and proves the exact sufficient equality criteria. Other noncollinear zero-lattice formulas follow by solving M^Tξ∈±α+Z² and orthogonality of MG^{-1}b to ker M^T. The corrected complete claim is proved; original equality classification was false.
